vedic_reference.note: The name Prachiti is derived from the Sanskrit word prachchhada, which means 'to adorn, decorate or cleanse'. In the Vedas, it is mentioned that the Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, purifies and decorates the mind and speech of a learner. The name Prachiti can be seen as a reflection of this purifying and decorating power of the goddess.
